method.momentum: P(month-end t-1) / P(month-end t-12) - 1, split-adjusted, signal month excluded
method.quality: mean percentile of ROE, ROIC, EBIT margin, equity/assets; at least 2; financials excluded
method.low_vol: trailing std of up to 252 close-to-close returns, min 120, gaps <= 5 days, sqrt(252)
method.composite: equal average of momentum, quality and low-vol percentiles inside their intersection
method.portfolio: equal-weight top quintile; cash if fewer than 25 scored names
method.liquidity: 60-session median BRL volume >= 1000000, print within 5 days
method.rebalance: signal at month-end or quarter-end close, fill at the next session close
method.costs: B3 taker fee, half-spread, participation slippage from trading_costs.quote_fill
method.cash: idle cash earns 0; CDI is a benchmark, not a credit inside the book
method.dividends: stock and equal-weight returns are price returns; dividends are not in the tape

oos_split.rule: Among the 4 sleeves and 2 rebalance frequencies at R$ 1 million, choose the highest net Sharpe on month-ends through 2018-12-31 (at least 36 months). Ties break to higher design CAGR, then lower turnover, then monthly, then factor name. AUM variants are registered and counted in N, and are not eligible to be chosen. The chosen sleeve is then scored on month-ends from 2019-01-01 onward. The path is not flattened at the split.
oos_split.criterion: DSR >= 0.95 on the out-of-sample net monthly returns, N = all registered trials, AND out-of-sample net CAGR minus CDI CAGR > 0

benchmark_ibov.note: Official Ibovespa level (B3 defines it as a gross total-return index, so cash dividends are already reinvested in the published series). No extra dividend was added. No investor cost.

benchmark_cdi.unit: daily percent converted to a decimal, compounded
benchmark_cdi.note: CDI is the opportunity cost. The factor book does not earn it on idle cash.

us.reason: No free point-in-time US stock or ETF panel that keeps delisted names was available. A survivor list from a chart API would not be this study. No US figure is reported.

verdict.note: A pass would still be paper research. It does not authorize capital.
